title: Add credential-fallback-orchestrator and stream.operator(authFallback) — TS SDK v1.27.0
author: Liam Chen
release_notes: TypeScript SDK v1.27.0: credential fallback orchestrator and stream.operator(authFallback) for ergonomic auth recovery, signal events for stream health, minor API refinements and changelog.
description: Context: production streaming clients observed transient auth failures during token rotations and provider flaps; SDKs had inconsistent fallback affordances. This PR introduces a compact CredentialFallbackOrchestrator (exported registry) plus a convenience stream operator stream.operator(authFallback(registryName, opts)) that wraps AsyncIterable streams and attempts controlled recovery on auth errors. Implementation is opt-in and backwards-compatible. The change also standardizes stream-level transient-auth retry presets across SDKs, adds an optional telemetry hook, and surfaces a lightweight 'signal' event for stream progress/failover observability. Includes unit and e2e tests, docs and a minor version bump to v1.27.0.

diff_snippets: export class CredentialFallbackOrchestrator { register(name: string, provider: FallbackProvider, opts?: {telemetryHook?: TelemetryHook}): void; get(name: string): FallbackProvider | undefined; }

export function authFallback(registryName: string, opts?: WithFallbackOpts) { return async function*(source: AsyncIterable<Chunk>) { try { for await (const c of source) { yield c } } catch (err) { if (isAuthError(err)) { const p = orchestrator.get(registryName); await p?.attemptRecovery(); /* replay/ retry */ } throw err } } }

merge_commit_message: feat(ts-sdk): credential fallback orchestrator + stream.operator(authFallback); bump v1.27.0 (438210)
migration_notes: No breaking changes. To opt in, register a fallback provider with CredentialFallbackOrchestrator.register('my-fallback', provider) and wrap streams with stream.operator(authFallback('my-fallback')). If you have custom fallback logic, a small shim can adapt existing providers to the orchestrator API. See docs/migration-auth-fallback.md for examples.
risk_and_rollout: Low-medium: opt-in API; monitor 'auth.fallback' telemetry signal for 72 hours post-release. No backport planned.
